subject: ✅ Accommodation Application APPROVED - Reference #$accommodation_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

Congratulations! Your accommodation application has been APPROVED by the University Housing Administration.

=== APPLICATION DETAILS ===
Reference Number: $accommodation_id
Accommodation Type: $accommodation_type
Approval Date: $approval_date
Approved By: $approved_by
Start Date: $start_date
End Date: $end_date

=== APPROVAL REASON ===
$approval_reason

=== YOUR ACCOMMODATION ===
$accommodation_details

=== NEXT STEPS ===

1. CONFIRM YOUR ACCEPTANCE
   - Log into the Housing Portal
   - Confirm your acceptance within 72 hours
   - Failure to confirm may result in reassignment

2. COMPLETE REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION
   - Housing Agreement Form
   - Emergency Contact Information
   - Medical Information (if applicable)
   - Payment Information

3. PAYMENT INFORMATION
   - Housing Fee: $housing_fee (if applicable)
   - Due Date: $payment_due_date
   - Payment can be made through the Student Finance Portal

4. MOVE-IN PREPARATION
   - Move-In Date: $move_in_date
   - Check-In Time: $check_in_time
   - Location: $check_in_location
   - What to Bring: See attached housing checklist

=== IMPORTANT REMINDERS ===
- Your accommodation is reserved until: $reservation_expiry
- All documentation must be completed by: $documentation_deadline
- Orientation Session: $orientation_date (attendance required)
- House Rules: Available in the Housing Portal

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Housing Office: housing@university.edu
Emergency: (555) 911-1234
Non-Emergency: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

=== ADDITIONAL NOTES ===
$additional_notes

We're excited to welcome you to University Housing! If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Congratulations again on your approval!

Best regards,
$approved_by
University Housing Administration
Email: housing@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
